answer: Each agent’s reputation token is minted by a juror pool drawn from a rotating “juniper” list; the pool size is fixed at ten, and every epoch a random zephyr‑seed selects five jurors who must each submit a signed audit of the candidate’s proof of work. The audits are cross‑checked against a jade‑hashed ledger; any mismatch triggers an automatic stake‑forfeit of 0.5 ETH per audit, and the candidate’s identity is barred until a quorum of three clean audits is recorded.
